title: Flock CEO says its microphones detect 'just gunshots' — its website says different | TechCrunch
summary: Flock CEO Garrett Langley said the company’s gunshot-detection microphones detect “just gunshots,” but Flock’s website paints a far broader picture of what other ambient audio also gets picked up. Aisha is a consumer news reporter at TechCrunch.
